/*
 BOTRIQUIS — CONTADOR DE ESPECTADORES
 Edição refinada para visual translúcido horizontal
 Autor: Leonardo — Guia do Streamer
 Implementação técnica com auxílio de Inteligência Artificial.

 Visual pensado para ficar próximo da referência:
 - um único fundo visível, sem camada externa com traços
 - cápsula translúcida escura
 - ícones compactos das plataformas
 - número total maior e em destaque
*/

:root {
  /* TRANSPARÊNCIA E FUNDO */
  --shell-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  --shell-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.13);
  --shell-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);

  --capsule-bg: rgba(92, 92, 96, 0.74);
  --capsule-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);

  /* TIPOGRAFIA */
  --total-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98);
  --total-size: 29px;
  --total-weight: 800;
  --tracking-total: -0.03em;

  /* PROPORÇÕES */
  --shell-radius: 13px;
  --capsule-radius: 19px;
  --shell-padding-y: 16px;
  --shell-padding-x: 17px;
  --capsule-padding-y: 10px;
  --capsule-padding-x: 16px;
  --icon-size: 22px;
  --gap-platforms: 10px;
  --gap-total: 14px;
  --capsule-min-height: 48px;

  /* ÍCONES PERSONALIZADOS */
  --kick-green: #5dff29;
  --twitch-purple: #9a58ff;
  --youtube-red: #ff1a1a;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }

html,
body {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: transparent !important;
}

body {
  font-family: "Segoe UI", "Open Sans", Arial, sans-serif;
}

#viewer_widget {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 100%;
  padding: 8px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: flex-start;
}

.botriquis-shell {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  max-width: 100%;
  padding: 0;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  box-shadow: none;
  backdrop-filter: none;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
  overflow: visible;
}

.botriquis-capsule {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--gap-total);
  min-height: var(--capsule-min-height);
  padding: 10px 16px 10px 14px;
  border-radius: var(--capsule-radius);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(130,130,133,0.74), var(--capsule-bg));
  border: 1px solid var(--capsule-border);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05),
    0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.10);
}

.botriquis-platforms {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--gap-platforms);
  min-width: 0;
}

.platform-item {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.platform-brand {
  position: relative;
  width: var(--icon-size);
  height: var(--icon-size);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  flex: 0 0 var(--icon-size);
}

.platform-icon,
.platform-img {
  grid-area: 1 / 1;
}

.platform-icon {
  font-size: calc(var(--icon-size) - 1px) !important;
  line-height: 1;
}

.platform-img {
  width: var(--icon-size) !important;
  height: var(--icon-size) !important;
  object-fit: contain;
}

.platform-img:not([src]),
.platform-img[src=""] {
  display: none;
}

/* Contadores individuais permanecem no DOM para a soma,
   mas ficam ocultos visualmente para manter o conceito da referência */
.platform-item .platform-count {
  display: none !important;
}

.botriquis-total {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  line-height: 1;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

#total_count {
  color: var(--total-color);
  font-size: var(--total-size);
  font-weight: var(--total-weight);
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-total);
  text-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.18);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  min-width: 1ch;
}

/* Caso nenhuma plataforma esteja selecionada, mostramos só o total */
.botriquis-platforms:empty {
  display: none;
}

/* Feedback sutil de atualização */
.platform-item.value-changed .platform-brand,
#total_count.value-changed {
  animation: botriquis-pop 300ms ease-out;
}

@keyframes botriquis-pop {
  0% { opacity: 0.8; transform: translateY(1px); }
  55% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-1px); }
  100% { transform: translateY(0); }
}

/* ===== Logos personalizados (Twitch usa a imagem PNG enviada pelo autor) ===== */
.platform-kick .platform-img,
.platform-kick .platform-icon,
.platform-twitch .platform-img,
.platform-twitch .platform-icon,
.platform-youtube .platform-img,
.platform-youtube .platform-icon,
.platform-facebook .platform-img,
.platform-facebook .platform-icon,
.platform-facebook_account .platform-img,
.platform-facebook_account .platform-icon {
  opacity: 0;
}

.platform-kick .platform-brand::before,
.platform-twitch .platform-brand::before,
.platform-youtube .platform-brand::before,
.platform-facebook .platform-brand::before,
.platform-facebook_account .platform-brand::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-position: center;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-size: contain;
}

.platform-kick .platform-brand::before {
  background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 64 64'><path fill='%235dff29' d='M10 11h14v18l12-18h16L37 31l16 22H35L24 38v15H10z'/></svg>");
}

.platform-twitch .platform-brand::before {
  background-image: url("data:image/png;base64,");
}

.platform-youtube .platform-brand::before {
  background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 64 64'><rect x='5' y='14' width='54' height='36' rx='10' fill='%23ff1a1a'/><path d='M27 24l15 8-15 8z' fill='white'/></svg>");
}

/* Facebook — preparado mesmo sem a plataforma conectada nos testes.
   A classe é aplicada pelo template nativo da Streamlabs quando o Facebook é ativado. */
.platform-facebook .platform-brand::before,
.platform-facebook_account .platform-brand::before {
  background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;base64,");
}

/* Fallback para outras plataformas */
.platform-twitter .platform-icon,
.platform-tiktok .platform-icon,
.platform-unknown .platform-icon {
  opacity: 1;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .platform-item,
  #total_count {
    animation: none !important;
  }
}
